tools.name: list_dossiers
tools.description: List all Octopus dossiers (company files) accessible to the authenticated user. Returns dossier IDs, descriptions, VAT numbers, and addresses. Use this to find the correct dossier ID for configuration.

tools.name: get_bookyears
tools.description: Get all bookyears (boekjaren) for the configured Octopus dossier. Returns bookyear IDs, descriptions, start/end dates, periods, and whether they are closed. Use the bookyear ID in other calls that require it.

tools.name: list_relations
tools.description: List all relations (clients and suppliers) in the configured Octopus dossier. Returns names, addresses, VAT numbers, bank accounts, contact details, and payment terms. Note: this endpoint is limited to 2 calls per day.

tools.name: list_accounts
tools.description: List the chart of accounts (rekeningschema) for a specific bookyear in the configured Octopus dossier. Returns account numbers, descriptions, VAT settings, and cost centre configuration. Requires a bookyear_id. Note: limited to 2 calls per day.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID to get accounts for. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

tools.name: list_journals
tools.description: List all journals (dagboeken) for a specific bookyear in the configured Octopus dossier. Returns journal keys (e.g. A1=Buy, V1=Sell, F1=Financial, D1=Divers), names, currency, and last booked document number. Requires a bookyear_id.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID to get journals for. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

tools.name: list_buy_sell_bookings
tools.description: Get buy or sell bookings (aan-/verkoopboekingen) from the configured Octopus dossier. Can filter by bookyear, journal, and document number. Returns booking details including relation, amounts, VAT, booking lines, and dates.

bookyear_id.description: Filter by bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (e.g. 'A1' for buy journal, 'V1' for sell journal). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Filter by specific document sequence number within a journal.

tools.name: list_invoices
tools.description: Get invoices (facturen) from the configured Octopus dossier. Can filter by bookyear, journal, and document number. Returns invoice details including relation, lines with products/quantities/prices, VAT, and dates. Note: requires the Invoice Module to be activated in the dossier.

bookyear_id.description: Filter by bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (e.g. 'V1' for sell invoices). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Filter by specific document sequence number within a journal.

tools.name: create_relation
tools.description: Create or update a relation (client/supplier) in the configured Octopus dossier. If a relation with the given relation_id or external_relation_id already exists, it will be updated (upsert). Otherwise a new relation is created. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

name.description: Full name of the relation (company or person name)

client.description: Whether this relation is a client (customer)

supplier.description: Whether this relation is a supplier

vat_number.description: VAT number. For Belgian companies use format BE0xxx.xxx.xxx

relation_id.description: Internal Octopus relation key (for updating an existing relation)

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID from your system (for matching/updating)

tools.name: create_buy_sell_booking
tools.description: Create a buy or sell booking (aan-/verkoopboeking) in the configured Octopus dossier. Use journal_key 'A1' for buy bookings, 'V1' for sell bookings. For credit notes, set amount to negative (but keep line amounts positive). First use get_bookyears to find the bookyear_id and list_journals to find the journal_key. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Journal code (e.g. 'A1' for buy, 'V1' for sell). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal. Check list_journals for the last booked document number.

period_nr.description: Bookyear period number (usually 1-12 for monthly periods)

expiry_date.description: Payment expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format

amount.description: Total booking amount (negative for credit notes)

relation_id.description: Internal Octopus relation key of the client/supplier

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID of the client/supplier

booking_lines.description: Booking lines with account details, amounts, and VAT

account_key.description: Account number (e.g. 600000 for purchases, 700000 for sales)

vat_code.description: VAT code (e.g. '21' for 21% VAT, '06' for 6%, 'D21' for deductible 21%)

tools.name: create_invoice
tools.description: Create a sell invoice (verkoopfactuur) in the configured Octopus dossier. Requires the Invoice Module to be activated. Uses V-journals (sell journals). For credit notes, both total and line amounts must be negative. At least one invoice_line is required. First use get_bookyears and list_journals to find the right IDs. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Sell journal code (e.g. 'V1'). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal

expiry_date.description: Payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format

relation_id.description: Internal Octopus relation key of the customer

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID of the customer

invoice_lines.description: Invoice lines with product details, quantities, and prices

tools.name: create_financial_divers_booking
tools.description: Create a financial or divers booking in the configured Octopus dossier. Use journal_key 'F1' for financial journals, 'D1' for divers. Each booking line must specify a type: 'A' for account line, 'C' for client line, 'S' for supplier line. At least one booking_line is required. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Journal code (e.g. 'F1' for financial, 'D1' for divers). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal

booking_lines.description: Booking lines. Each line must have a type ('A'=Account, 'C'=Client, 'S'=Supplier) and an amount.

type.description: 'A' for account line, 'C' for client line, 'S' for supplier line

relation_id.description: Relation ID (required when type is 'C' or 'S')

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID (alternative to relation_id for type 'C' or 'S')

amount.description: Amount (positive for debit, negative for credit)

tools.name: get_api_version
tools.description: Get the Octopus API version number. Does not require a dossier connection.

tools.name: get_bookyear
tools.description: Get a specific bookyear by ID from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns bookyear details including description, start/end dates, periods, and whether it is closed.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID to retrieve. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

tools.name: get_cost_centres
tools.description: Get all cost centres from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns cost centre details including IDs, descriptions, and status.

tools.name: get_active_cost_centres
tools.description: Get all active (not closed) cost centres from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns cost centre details including IDs, descriptions, and status.

tools.name: get_products
tools.description: Get all products from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns product details including IDs, descriptions, prices, and settings.

tools.name: get_product_groups
tools.description: Get all product groups from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns product group details including IDs and descriptions.

tools.name: get_vat_codes
tools.description: Get all VAT codes from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns VAT code details including codes, descriptions, and percentages.

tools.name: get_currencies
tools.description: Get all currencies from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns currency details including codes and descriptions.

tools.name: get_custom_fields
tools.description: Get all custom fields from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns custom field definitions including names, types, and settings.

tools.name: list_financial_divers_bookings
tools.description: Get financial or divers bookings from the configured Octopus dossier. Can filter by bookyear, journal, and document number. Returns booking details including amounts, dates, and booking lines.

bookyear_id.description: Filter by bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (e.g. 'F1' for financial, 'D1' for divers). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Filter by specific document sequence number within a journal.

tools.name: list_delivery_notes
tools.description: Get delivery notes from the configured Octopus dossier. Can filter by bookyear, journal, and document number. Returns delivery note details including relation, lines, and dates.

bookyear_id.description: Filter by bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (e.g. 'L1' for delivery notes). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Filter by specific document sequence number within a journal.

tools.name: get_payment_list
tools.description: Get the payment list from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns all payments in the payment list including amounts, references, and bank details.

tools.name: get_unbalanced_invoices
tools.description: Get unbalanced invoices from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns invoices that have not been fully paid or balanced.

tools.name: get_envelopes
tools.description: Get all payment envelopes from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns envelope details including IDs, descriptions, and status.

tools.name: get_envelope_content
tools.description: Get the content of a specific payment envelope from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns envelope details including all payments contained within the envelope.

envelope_key_id.description: The envelope key ID to retrieve content for.

tools.name: get_rappels
tools.description: Get rappel information from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns rappel details for invoices that are overdue as of the specified expiration date.

expiration_date.description: The expiration date to check for overdue invoices (YYYY-MM-DD format).

tools.name: export_rappel
tools.description: Export a rappel (reminder) as PDF from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns the rappel data including PDF content if requested.

relation_id.description: The relation ID for the rappel.

tools.name: export_invoice
tools.description: Export an invoice as PDF or eInvoice XML from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns the invoice data including PDF content if requested.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID of the invoice.

journal_key.description: The journal key of the invoice.

document_sequence_nr.description: The document sequence number of the invoice.

return_pdf.description: Whether to include PDF content in the response.

tools.name: export_delivery_note
tools.description: Export a delivery note as PDF from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns the delivery note data including PDF content if requested.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID of the delivery note.

journal_key.description: The journal key of the delivery note.

document_sequence_nr.description: The document sequence number of the delivery note.

return_pdf.description: Whether to include PDF content in the response.

tools.name: get_financial_journal_balance
tools.description: Get the balance of a financial journal from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns the journal balance information for the specified bookyear and journal.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID.

journal_key.description: The journal key (e.g. 'F1' for financial journal).

tools.name: get_journal_entry
tools.description: Get a specific journal entry from the configured Octopus dossier. Supports all journal types: A=Buy, V=Sell, F=Financial, D=Divers, L=Delivery.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID.

journal_type.description: The journal type: A=Buy, V=Sell, F=Financial, D=Divers, L=Delivery.

sequence_number.description: The sequence number within the journal.

tools.name: get_invoice_delivery_states
tools.description: Get invoice delivery states from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns delivery status information for invoices within the specified range.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (optional).

tools.name: report_history_accounts
tools.description: Generate a history accounts report from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns historical account data for the specified period and bookyear.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID for the report.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (optional).

tools.name: report_open_accounts
tools.description: Generate an open accounts report from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns open account data for the specified period and bookyear.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID for the report.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (optional).

tools.name: report_history_clients
tools.description: Generate a history clients report from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns historical client data for the specified period and bookyear.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID for the report.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (optional).

tools.name: report_open_clients
tools.description: Generate an open clients report from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns open client data for the specified period and bookyear.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID for the report.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (optional).

tools.name: report_history_suppliers
tools.description: Generate a history suppliers report from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns historical supplier data for the specified period and bookyear.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID for the report.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (optional).

tools.name: report_open_suppliers
tools.description: Generate an open suppliers report from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns open supplier data for the specified period and bookyear.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID for the report.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (optional).

tools.name: report_history_cost_centres
tools.description: Generate a history cost centres report from the configured Octopus dossier. Returns historical cost centre data for the specified period and bookyear.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID for the report.

journal_key.description: Filter by journal key (optional).

tools.name: create_or_update_account
tools.description: Create or update an account in the configured Octopus dossier. This is an upsert operation: if an account with the given account_key already exists in the specified bookyear, it will be updated. Otherwise a new account is created. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID where the account should be created/updated.

vat_code.description: Default VAT code for this account.

cost_centre_required.description: Whether cost centre is required for bookings on this account.

blocked.description: Whether the account is blocked for new bookings.

tools.name: create_or_update_cost_centre
tools.description: Create or update a cost centre in the configured Octopus dossier. This is an upsert operation: if a cost centre with the given ID already exists, it will be updated. Otherwise a new cost centre is created. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

cost_centre_id.description: Cost centre ID (for updating an existing cost centre).

closed.description: Whether the cost centre is closed.

tools.name: create_or_update_product
tools.description: Create or update a product in the configured Octopus dossier. This is an upsert operation: if a product with the given ID already exists, it will be updated. Otherwise a new product is created. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

product_id.description: Product ID (for updating an existing product).

tools.name: update_buy_sell_booking
tools.description: Update a buy or sell booking in the configured Octopus dossier. Updates an existing booking with new data. Use journal_key 'A1' for buy bookings, 'V1' for sell bookings. For credit notes, set amount to negative (but keep line amounts positive). Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Journal code (e.g. 'A1' for buy, 'V1' for sell). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal.

period_nr.description: Bookyear period number (usually 1-12 for monthly periods)

expiry_date.description: Payment expiry date in YYYY-MM-DD format

amount.description: Total booking amount (negative for credit notes)

relation_id.description: Internal Octopus relation key of the client/supplier

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID of the client/supplier

booking_lines.description: Booking lines with account details, amounts, and VAT

account_key.description: Account number (e.g. 600000 for purchases, 700000 for sales)

vat_code.description: VAT code (e.g. '21' for 21% VAT, '06' for 6%, 'D21' for deductible 21%)

tools.name: update_invoice
tools.description: Update a sell invoice in the configured Octopus dossier. Updates an existing invoice with new data. Requires the Invoice Module to be activated. Uses V-journals (sell journals). For credit notes, both total and line amounts must be negative. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Sell journal code (e.g. 'V1'). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal

expiry_date.description: Payment due date in YYYY-MM-DD format

relation_id.description: Internal Octopus relation key of the customer

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID of the customer

invoice_lines.description: Invoice lines with product details, quantities, and prices

tools.name: update_financial_divers_booking
tools.description: Update a financial or divers booking in the configured Octopus dossier. Updates an existing booking with new data. Use journal_key 'F1' for financial journals, 'D1' for divers. Each booking line must specify a type: 'A' for account line, 'C' for client line, 'S' for supplier line. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Journal code (e.g. 'F1' for financial, 'D1' for divers). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal

booking_lines.description: Booking lines. Each line must have a type ('A'=Account, 'C'=Client, 'S'=Supplier) and an amount.

type.description: 'A' for account line, 'C' for client line, 'S' for supplier line

relation_id.description: Relation ID (required when type is 'C' or 'S')

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID (alternative to relation_id for type 'C' or 'S')

amount.description: Amount (positive for debit, negative for credit)

tools.name: create_delivery_note
tools.description: Create a delivery note in the configured Octopus dossier. Creates a new delivery note with the specified details. Similar structure to invoices but for delivery tracking purposes. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Journal code (e.g. 'L1' for delivery notes). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal

relation_id.description: Internal Octopus relation key of the customer

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID of the customer

delivery_lines.description: Delivery lines with product details, quantities, and prices

tools.name: update_delivery_note
tools.description: Update a delivery note in the configured Octopus dossier. Updates an existing delivery note with new data. Similar structure to invoices but for delivery tracking purposes. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID. Use get_bookyears to find available IDs.

journal_key.description: Journal code (e.g. 'L1' for delivery notes). Use list_journals to find available keys.

document_sequence_nr.description: Document sequence number within the journal

relation_id.description: Internal Octopus relation key of the customer

external_relation_id.description: External relation ID of the customer

delivery_lines.description: Delivery lines with product details, quantities, and prices

tools.name: insert_balancing
tools.description: Insert a balancing entry in the configured Octopus dossier. Creates a balancing entry to match payments with invoices or other documents. Rate limit: 400 calls/day.

bookyear_id.description: Bookyear ID of the document

journal_key.description: Journal key of the document

tools.name: generate_invoice
tools.description: Generate an invoice PDF from the configured Octopus dossier. Generates a server-side PDF for an existing invoice and optionally publishes it to the DMS (Document Management System).

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID of the invoice.

journal_key.description: The journal key of the invoice.

document_sequence_nr.description: The document sequence number of the invoice.

return_invoice.description: Whether to return invoice data (default: true).

publish_pdf_in_dms.description: Whether to publish PDF in DMS (default: false).

publish_e_invoice_in_dms.description: Whether to publish e-invoice in DMS (default: false).

return_pdf_document.description: Whether to return PDF content (default: false).

return_e_invoice_xml.description: Whether to return e-invoice XML (default: false).

tools.name: generate_delivery_note
tools.description: Generate a delivery note PDF from the configured Octopus dossier. Generates a server-side PDF for an existing delivery note and optionally publishes it to the DMS (Document Management System).

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID of the delivery note.

journal_key.description: The journal key of the delivery note.

document_sequence_nr.description: The document sequence number of the delivery note.

return_delivery_note.description: Whether to return delivery note data (default: true).

publish_pdf_in_dms.description: Whether to publish PDF in DMS (default: false).

return_pdf_document.description: Whether to return PDF content (default: false).

tools.name: book_invoices
tools.description: Book invoices in the configured Octopus dossier. Books through invoices in a journal, making them final and immutable. Optionally attaches UBL (Universal Business Language) data.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID.

journal_key.description: The journal key to book invoices in.

to_document_sequence_nr.description: Book up to this document sequence number (optional).

tools.name: send_invoices
tools.description: Send invoices from the configured Octopus dossier. Generates and sends invoices via email or other delivery methods.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID.

journal_key.description: The journal key.

from_document_sequence_nr.description: Start from this document sequence number.

to_document_sequence_nr.description: Send up to this document sequence number.

tools.name: add_invoice_to_payment_list
tools.description: Add an invoice to the payment list in the configured Octopus dossier. Adds an existing invoice to the payment list for batch processing.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID of the invoice.

journal_key.description: The journal key of the invoice.

document_sequence_nr.description: The document sequence number of the invoice.

amount.description: Payment amount (optional, defaults to invoice amount).

tools.name: add_free_payment
tools.description: Add a free payment to the payment list in the configured Octopus dossier. Adds a standalone payment entry that is not linked to a specific invoice.

tools.name: create_envelope
tools.description: Create a payment envelope in the configured Octopus dossier. Creates a new envelope for grouping payments together for batch processing.

tools.name: update_envelope
tools.description: Update a payment envelope in the configured Octopus dossier. Updates an existing envelope with new information.

envelope_key_id.description: The envelope key ID to update.

tools.name: add_payment_to_envelope
tools.description: Add a payment to an envelope in the configured Octopus dossier. Adds a payment from the payment list to an existing envelope.

envelope_key_id.description: The envelope key ID to add the payment to.

payment_list_key_id.description: The payment list key ID of the payment to add.

tools.name: remove_payment_from_envelope
tools.description: Remove a payment from an envelope in the configured Octopus dossier. Removes a payment from an existing envelope, returning it to the general payment list.

envelope_key_id.description: The envelope key ID to remove the payment from.

payment_list_key_id.description: The payment list key ID of the payment to remove.

tools.name: export_envelope
tools.description: Export an envelope from the configured Octopus dossier. Exports an envelope with all its payments for external processing or archiving.

envelope_key_id.description: The envelope key ID to export.

tools.name: create_bookyear
tools.description: Create a new bookyear in the configured Octopus dossier. Creates a new accounting year with the specified settings and periods.

start_date.description: Start date of the bookyear in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date of the bookyear in YYYY-MM-DD format.

number_of_periods.description: Number of periods in the bookyear (usually 12).

closed.description: Whether the bookyear is closed (defaults to false).

tools.name: update_bookyear
tools.description: Update an existing bookyear in the configured Octopus dossier. Updates bookyear settings such as description, dates, and status.

bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID to update.

start_date.description: Start date of the bookyear in YYYY-MM-DD format.

end_date.description: End date of the bookyear in YYYY-MM-DD format.

number_of_periods.description: Number of periods in the bookyear (usually 12).

tools.name: book_bookyear
tools.description: Book a bookyear to the next bookyear in the configured Octopus dossier. Transfers the closing balances from one bookyear to the opening balances of the next bookyear.

from_bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID to book from.

to_bookyear_id.description: The bookyear ID to book to.

copy_all_account_descriptions.description: Whether to copy all account descriptions (defaults to false).

octopus_password.description: Het wachtwoord van je Octopus account

software_house_id.label: Software House ID
software_house_id.description: Software House UUID verkregen van Octopus (aanvragen via webservice@octopus.be)
